# Safety-relevant paths, one glob per line (`**` matches any depth, `*` one level).
# A reviewer must read every changed file that matches a line here and list it under
# "Reviewed files" in the verdict; an unread match makes the verdict request_changes.
# Removing or narrowing a line weakens the review and is itself a blocking finding.
# tools/tests/test_critical_paths.py checks that every line above the "planned" marker
# matches at least one tracked file, so a move or rename cannot silently drop a path.
